Kholai

Overview

Kholai is a necromancer removed from the imperial laboratory by Taivo. He wants his rival disgraced rather than killed. In return for a dead scientist’s head, he summons the spirit and interprets its account of the attack on the Joon’s captors. His explanation sends Zak to search for the remains of a teleportation amulet. [1, 2, 3]

Kholai and the dead scientist

Kehel directs Zak to Kholai, whom Taivo displaced from the imperial laboratory. Kholai wants disgrace for his rival rather than a simple assassination. Zak steals a dead scientist’s head from the laboratory; its disappearance will embarrass Taivo, and Kholai can summon its spirit. The scientist describes a horror pursuing the red-skinned youth. To conceal him, the scholars changed his appearance and sent him away by teleportation. Kholai interprets the broken testimony and tells Zak to search the ruined mansion for the magical object used in the escape. The fragments Zak finds are beyond Kehel’s ability to interpret: only a Great Magician can identify the destination. Kholai can also give Zak an experimental object to test in combat. He is interested in the result even if the trial kills its user, a further sign of the limits of his concern for his visitor. [4, 1, 5, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8]
